name: r1_demo
description: DEMO fixture for the R1 hybrid-retrieval ladder (harness sanity check, NOT a promotion decision). Covers all seven families with deliberate low-overlap exact-string/symbol support plus high-overlap distractors so the source-aware path can be distinguished from the fused baseline. The real fixture, grounded in menhir/archolith history with confirmed gold support ids, is a ctharvey pairing task.

memories.text: Postmortem note: the failure signature was NullPointerException at PaymentGateway.charge line 42 during settlement.
The checkout flow occasionally crashes and the user sees a generic failure during settlement and payment.
Settlement and payment failures during checkout are usually transient and resolve on retry of the flow.
Refactored the nightly job so TcgPlayerDailyScheduler.ensurePartition runs before the price import begins.
The nightly price import job creates a new daily partition before it begins importing rows.
Daily price import begins each night and writes rows into the partitioned snapshots table.
Current decision: the recall similarity floor behaves as a rank cut on the RRF scale, not a cosine cutoff.
Old note: the recall similarity floor is a cosine threshold around 0.15 where genuine matches exceed 0.3.
In the dashboard project the hybrid alpha slider blends two retrieval scores for the demo view.
In menhir, hybrid_alpha is a rank-fusion weight blending vector and BM25 passes in recall.
Edge case fixed: SeedScopedIngest.resolveColors preserves primaryColor when the upstream source omits it.
exact_strings: preserves primaryColor when the upstream source omits it
